title: Periodic inspection.
officialText:
Inspection of bolt installation for pretensioning is permitted to be performed on a periodic basis
when using the turn-of-nut method with matchmarking techniques, the direct tension indicator method or the alternate design
fastener (twist-off bolt) method. Joints designated as snug tight need be inspected only on a periodic basis.
